knownDeltas: The sampled value comes from the replay raster (8x6 gradient, value (row*16+col) with a north-up flip: probe (2.5,1.5) reads row 4 col 2 = 66); an Esri sample service would return its own pixel. The identify envelope (value/location, no catalogItems without a catalog) is the parity contract.
name: imageserver-identify
notes: Identify (ImageServer/identify): doc-pattern point probe over the published raster; the replay pins the sampled value plus location.
source: Esri REST docs: Identify (Image Service) (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/identify-image-service-.htm); geometry/geometryType pattern
